subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e666a901f5bdc3d0ea1b8c1f65c09ca6e3fde92cb9873642297a266447832890.png] 

Logic follows here is that the first letter is increased by 7 and the second letter is decreased by 4.

Option 1) CJF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f8c96010126e8580aa966680f3fe2240e5f4d9a9a60d4ea46ceadfa34dd9286.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f30e3d783412413f4c04eddf5c916d375b5ee89e64acef4cbd48f6e17262c8f.png] 

Option 2) ELH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26b7f99b3a019d22659a9947f77879548bac9cfc8eff6e70a8fcbcd298fc42ce.png] 

Option 3) IPL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f48deedfa217ac69f27aa1afbd0b16208b0d8756c304eebd02dd979f45bbc0ef.png]
